name: Wendigo
ability: Erase a Town Card. If there's at least 4 cards in the graveyard, gain another fear. If 8 cards, also draw a card. If 12, inflict 1 suspicion. If 16, double this effect.

name: Mothman
ability: Copy the effect of a town card whose cost is 3 or less.

name: Flatwoods Monster
modifier: At the start of the game, shuffle the drone deck and place it face-down near the shop. Once per turn, either player can gain a drone, at the cost of 1 suspicion.
ability: Erase every drone in your hand. For each erased, choose: draw two cards, gain 3 fear, or inflict 2 suspicion.

name: Loveland Frogman
modifier: At the start of the game, take your Magic Die and place it in a convenient location.
ability: Roll the die. If it lands on 1-3, get that amount of Fear. 4-5, draw two cards. 6 - self-inflict 2 Suspicion.
